policy: A confirmed semantic bug class is closed only when its content-addressed record is GUARDED and every reproducer/guard reference remains present and machine-checkable.

classes.description: Qualification tests must derive mutable canonical qualification state from the registry and ledger instead of hard-coding a previously attested commit or pre-promotion state.

first_observed.signature: test_default_explorer_remains_fail_closed_without_external_artifact: expected False but canonical-static qualification was True

classes.root_cause: The qualification provenance promotion changed canonical source truth from NOT_RUN to PASS, while overlay tests retained historical state oracles. The tests were coupled to a prior repository epoch instead of the canonical state machine.
classes.closure_rule: Canonical qualification state is data-derived; a registered guard forbids a hard-coded promoted qualification SHA oracle; bug-sweep verifies the content-addressed class and guard references.

classes.description: Qualification failure cleanup must succeed even when execution stops before heartbeat or phase-log creation.

first_observed.signature: gzip: heartbeat.jsonl: No such file or directory

classes.root_cause: The always-run diagnostic finalizer treated an optional heartbeat file as mandatory, allowing cleanup to add a second failure and obscure the primary pre-Lean test failure.
classes.closure_rule: Failure-path finalization is standalone and idempotent, tolerates absent optional evidence, and the always-run workflow wrapper cannot replace a prior failure with a cleanup failure; fault injection is permanent and workflow usage is verified by bug-sweep.

classes.description: Repository bug sweep must run from a clean isolated interpreter without requiring CACE to be installed as a package.

first_observed.signature: canonical-contract-links: unexpected ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cace_studio'

classes.root_cause: The sweep is launched as `python scripts/check_bug_sweep.py`, so Python seeds sys.path with the scripts directory. Canonical contract-link checks imported cace_studio as though the repository root were already importable or the package were installed, but the clean validation venv intentionally installs only pytest.
classes.closure_rule: The standalone sweep explicitly bootstraps the repository root before importing CACE modules; an isolated-interpreter subprocess test proves that no ambient PYTHONPATH or package installation is required; bug-sweep verifies the permanent guard references.
